symptom: next build fails: useSearchParams() should be wrapped in a suspense boundary at page /heuristic-summary.
rootcause: The summary reads query parameters without a parent Suspense boundary. Development rendering does not exercise the static-export requirement.
fix: Add the route loading boundary; new calculation pages use a shared Suspense-wrapped shell.
recurrence_risk: New query-dependent routes can omit their boundary.
prevention: The existing CI npm run build step fails on missing query Suspense boundaries. Typechecking alone cannot detect this.
